label: Stress probability
description: Out-of-fold P(deficit) from a leave-one-plant-out logistic model on all sensors' baseline-delta traits.

label: Stress probability (fusion model)
description: Out-of-fold P(deficit) from the fusion model on DOFA / ImageBind embeddings of all sensors present; 5 folds grouped by plant.

label: Severity stage (fusion model)
description: Expected stage 0-3 from the ordinal head (S0 healthy to S3 severe), out of fold.

label: Turgor deviation (fusion model)
description: Predicted leaf-clip shift from the turgor head, out of fold.
